summary: Iteration 50 — STT 'STT 502: <!DOCTYPE html>' bug is FIXED and verified end-to-end. Backend: pytest 11/11 GREEN (iter49 6/6 + new iter50 5/5). The root cause fix (`stt.transcribe(file=<open handle>, model='whisper-1', language='hi', prompt=...)`) plus the 502→400 status change now guarantee JSON responses through the Kubernetes ingress. Verified via PUBLIC URL (https://cyber-logistics-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com): (a) random bytes → HTTP 400 with `application/json` body `{"detail":"STT upstream error: ... Invalid file format..."}` — no HTML markers, no more 502; (b) missing `audio` field → 400 JSON `{"detail":"Missing \`audio\` file"}`; (c) silent 16-bit mono WAV → 200 JSON `{"text":""}`; (d) backward-compat alias `/api/assistant/stt` returns the same 400 (not 502) for garbage bytes. Zero occurrences of the old `transcribe_audio` AttributeError in the last 200 KB of supervisor logs. Frontend (kishan/Kishan@Boss2026 via 'Quick login as Kishan Sir (demo)'): long-press 1500ms on `now-brief-mic` → 'Sun raha hoon…' red chip + pink waveform appear during hold; on release the recording is uploaded and produces a valid AURA Hinglish reply (headless-Chrome-with-fake-mic sent silence → Whisper hallucinated 'Thank you for watching it.' → AURA replied 'Namaste Sir! 🙏 Koi baat nahi — maine dekha. Ab batayein, aaj kya kaam hai? Kya shipment status check karni hai, ya naya consignment book karni hai? AURA inventory mein current situation dekh raha hoon.'). CRITICAL assertion held: `document.body.innerText` after the entire mic flow contained ZERO of `<!doctype`, `<html`, `<body`, or `<style` — verified in the Now Brief card scope too. Regression: text-input flow still returns a Hinglish AI reply that references real AURA-* shipment IDs (`AURA-IT-002`, `AURA-IT-001`, `AURA-PEN-001`, `AURA-DEL-002`, `AURA-DEL-001`) — no HTML leakage there either. Both defence-in-depth HTML-sanitisers (wingman-api.ts `transcribeAudio` + now-brief-card.tsx `onMicPressOut` catch) are correctly wired with matching regex `/<!doctype|<html|<body(|<style)/i` and never triggered because the backend never returned HTML — the primary fix removed the need, and the sanitisers protect against any future regressions (ingress error pages, CDN outages, etc.). No new expo/react-native issues beyond the pre-existing shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver P2 warnings flagged in iter42/47/48/49.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2066-2070 — the 502→400 change is clean and correctly commented ('so the K8s ingress passes our JSON body through instead of substituting its own HTML 502 error page'). This is the correct architectural fix; 400 semantically fits 'client sent invalid audio' better than 502 anyway.

wingman-api.ts:85-95 — HTML detection regex `/<!doctype|<html|<body/i` is applied on the error body before throwing; the thrown Error carries the sanitised Hinglish message. Defence-in-depth is correct.

now-brief-card.tsx:475-486 — a second HTML sanitiser in the onMicPressOut catch adds `<style` to the marker set. Idempotent with the wingman-api layer — safe redundancy, exactly what defence-in-depth means.

Both regexes and the backend 400 status all agree — no chance of the original HTML leak recurring under normal ingress behaviour. If the ingress ever returns HTML for a 4xx (it doesn't today), the frontend still catches it.

rca_of_issue: ORIGINAL SYMPTOM: 'STT 502: <!DOCTYPE html>...' rendered in the Now Brief error card. TWO ROOT CAUSES fully addressed across iter49+iter50: (1) `OpenAISpeechToText.transcribe_audio(...)` method did not exist — fixed in iter49 by switching to `stt.transcribe(file=<open binary handle>, model='whisper-1', language='hi', prompt=...)`. (2) When STT genuinely fails (invalid audio bytes, litellm errors), the backend used to raise HTTPException(502); the K8s ingress then rewrote any 5xx into its own HTML 'Bad gateway' page before it reached the browser, and the frontend rendered that HTML raw — REPRODUCING the exact user-visible symptom. Fixed in iter50 by changing the exception to HTTPException(400, ...) which the ingress passes through unmodified as JSON. Additionally, frontend transcribeAudio() and onMicPressOut catch now detect stray `<!doctype|<html|<body|<style` and substitute a clean Hinglish message — defence in depth. Verified via pytest 11/11 GREEN and Playwright long-press + text-input runs against the public URL: zero HTML fragments in `document.body.innerText` after the full mic + text-send flow.
